subject: TUI W6 working environment wired end to end, PR 284 open
result: Picked up #282 (the audit of what #211 left unclosed) and closed its W6 half. W6 was entirely unimplemented: aikit-tui could not reach a working-environment provider, no Open/Focus UiAction existed, and MuxWorkingEnvironment had no production caller outside a diagnostic probe. Landed on branch agent/tui-w6-live-field, PR https://github.com/EpiLogos/ai-kit/pull/284 (2137 insertions, 16 files). Moved the pure observation vocabulary from aikit-adapters into aikit_core::working_environment so the TUI can read it without depending on adapters (adapters re-export; no provider import path changed). Added aikit-tui/src/live_field.rs: a derived, stateless reading of which providers reach a canonical subject and whether each can open or focus it now, keeping native pane ids as provenance and never as identity, and keeping apart the three facts of no-provider-attached, no-provider-running, and providers-present. Open/focus reach the operator through the existing contextual-Action lane rather than a new keymap. aikit-cli/src/working_environment_field.rs observes tmux and cmux over the same SessionPlan with the same canonical Surface refs, which is what makes one-subject-two-projections true. Two defects found by running against this machine rather than fixtures: an installed mux that will not answer (cmux, dead control socket here) was raising and would have taken the whole Worlds pane down, now an unavailable provider carrying its reason; and nothing was openable at all because no subject binds until a session exists, so the field now carries what the plan can project as well as what is live. Evidence: real-tmux round trip test proves not-live to open to native pane to focusable to focused with the canonical Ref unchanged; cargo test --workspace 240 binaries 0 failures; clippy clean. Open remainder on #282: W3 primary actions blocked on #227 (no session-start contract exists at the application boundary), W7 (credential world has no production call site, doctor and gateway absent from the TUI), W9 (five of six destinations have no golden coverage; narrow-width truncation), W10 (physical proving matrix largely unrun). Also open and awaiting the owner: PRs 279, 280, 281 are green and mergeable but unmerged; they are the fixes #282 itself cites as landed here.
